tasks.title: Define local policy state and active-feature resolution
tasks.dod: The shared policy contract resolves one explicitly active feature, blocks ambiguous project-wide writes, and preserves legacy behavior without opt-in.

tasks.title: Discover and explicitly select eligible repositories
tasks.dod: Discovery excludes ineligible checkouts, selection is explicit with the documents repository mandatory, and invalid saved paths require reselection.

tasks.title: Enforce safe branch-setup preflight
tasks.dod: Setup blocks dirty or unapproved branch bases and inactive target-branch collisions without switching or modifying user work.

tasks.title: Record checkout identity and verify local write access
tasks.dod: Required local metadata permissions and checkout UUID identity are verified and failures stop before feature artifacts.

tasks.title: Create feature branches and resume pending setup
tasks.dod: Missing slug branches are created without checkout; pending state resumes safely and becomes active only after manual activation and full verification.

tasks.title: Enforce the shared branch gate at every write boundary
tasks.dod: The shared gate checks all selected repositories before stage writes and rechecks before feature writes and commits without relying on host hooks.

tasks.title: Wire the first 12 registered skills to the branch gate
tasks.dod: The api, clarify, classify-size, config, data-model, decide-adr, design, design-system, fix, glossary, implement, and interview entrypoints use the shared gate.

tasks.title: Wire the remaining 11 registered skills to the branch gate
tasks.dod: The plan-tests, review, roadmap, scaffold, screens, sequences, ship, specify, survey, tasks, and ux-flows entrypoints use the shared gate.

tasks.title: Validate branch-gate coverage in CI
tasks.dod: The existing validator dynamically checks every registered skill entrypoint for the canonical branch-gate invocation and fails with the missing path.

tasks.title: Document host-hook information as non-enforcing
tasks.dod: README and host-adapter guidance describe host hooks as informational and name the shared skill gate as the only required check.

tasks.title: Add safe-setup acceptance scenarios
tasks.dod: The host-driven setup matrix asserts unsafe states block, reports each repository, and preserves existing work and branches.

tasks.title: Add active-gate and performance evaluation scenarios
tasks.dod: The host-driven gate matrix verifies active and ambiguous feature behavior, cross-repository blocking, legacy compatibility, hook independence, and the specified local preflight benchmark.
